title: Slow checkout with healthy payments
query: Checkout is crawling and the gateway keeps handing back 502s. Payments answers quickly, but orders keeps logging database trouble and I'm not sure why.
root_cause: The orders database connection pool is exhausted because connections are held and not returned.

remediation.detail: Restart orders to release the held connections.

evidence: Orders logs show database error entries
Payments latency and error ratio are normal
The gateway returns 502 because orders returns 503
